brandStory.title: 20 Years Connecting Chinese Industry with Global Buyers
paragraphs: We are a Chinese trading house that bridges the country's leading enterprises — state-owned groups, listed companies and large manufacturers — with overseas buyers in Southeast Asia, Africa and other Belt & Road markets.

In two decades of exports we've built lasting business ties with well-known companies worldwide, earned an AAA credit rating, and kept our service fees lean. For commodities not listed here, just send us your requirement — we respond fast with quality, cost-effective supply.

items.text: They quoted our aluminum and steel order quickly, handled all export documentation, and the goods arrived exactly to spec. Their 20 years of experience show in every shipment.
